requirements.change: Warmup completes before retained synchronization. Regression uses Arena.arena(), first enemy hover, an obstacle over the expanded intent rectangle, then controller focus on that same enemy. Checks parent HUD, actual retained HUD and effects geometry against an independent reference.

Deferred flush checks tree membership before clearing its dirty flag; _enter_tree reschedules it. Regression detaches after hovering enemy 2, lets the deferred callback run while detached, reattaches and requires enemy 2 without further input. A second regression reattaches before the original deferred callback runs.

Frozen pre-perf04 submission and layout oracle never invokes candidate warmup or submission reuse. Its untimed final HUD solve bypasses the HUD LRU and directly publishes HUD/effects bindings. Badge reference has original catalog keys. Pose and catalog mutation/restoration cases exercise invalidation. Production retained overlay and foreground callbacks run with changing selectors/clocks. Compare per-tile overlay inputs and glow polygons plus complete ordered torch sprite/trail inputs, including exact texture pixels and atlas selection. Native probe keeps real retained layers and has a 42-image pixel-equivalence contract.
